sentence: This project builds a center that studies quantum materials and quantum sensing.
This project studies how iron in humid tropical soils changes the way soil microorganisms release carbon dioxide as temperature rises.
This project develops methods that use simulations to work out the input values of complex models when there are many parameters.
This project creates techniques that use the physical properties of flash memory to make data storage more secure and energy-efficient.
This project builds a smart bandage that uses thin-film batteries and wireless electronics to check how chronic wounds are healing.
This project builds an imaging platform that measures the chemical composition inside thick, highly scattering specimens.
This project adds computing resources that support research on wildfire management, solar event prediction, and how the brain works.
This project develops deep-learning models that simulate how proteins change over longer time scales than traditional methods can.
This project studies how the green alga Chlamydomonas divides and how that is coordinated with the division of its chloroplast.
This project uses machine learning and computer simulations to study how light changes the properties of metal halide perovskites.
This project designs metasurfaces that control several properties of light at once so a single device can handle more information.
This project develops methods that rebuild a 3D scene from many camera views, using curves and surfaces of objects.
This project studies how nanomaterials that carry carbohydrates interact with bacterial proteins, toxins and cells.
This project sets up a cybersecurity program that includes research and ethics courses.
This project develops an automated way to test protocol implementations by feeding them inputs to find bugs.
This project adds lessons on medical imaging, portable ultrasound and artificial intelligence to a bioengineering curriculum.
This project develops models based on topology and deep learning to help control power grids with many distributed energy resources.
